title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
reason: Frontier-lab product launch with multi-source coverage introducing agentic payments, a frontier-shifting release for AI readers.

sources.summary: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet, a secure way for agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots to complete purchases with user approval and existing card protections.
ChatGPT Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out on users' behalf, starting with a limited rollout to U.S. Pro subscribers.
